h2: Compare all six container cafe sizes and what each one trades as
intro: Six sizes, 100 to 400 sq ft - one delivered unit in every case, on one base, with one connection.

panels.paragraph: The smallest unit we publish. At 550 kg it lifts on a hydra and lands on any level 14 by 14 ft patch, which is why it suits mall forecourts, campus corners and event grounds where the pitch is borrowed rather than owned. Its 0.7 kW load runs off a domestic-grade supply, so no separate sanction is needed before you open.

Eight feet of width is the real container dimension, and this is the size buyers ask for when the unit has to read as a shipping container on sight. That narrow span puts the serving counter and the back bar on opposite walls with one working aisle between them. It carries the same Rs 2,035 rate as the smallest unit, because width rather than length is what drives the fabrication cost, and the frame section does not change between the two.

Our reference size, and the one both the published price and the specification sheet are written against. Two more feet of width turn a working aisle into a room. The rate drops to Rs 1,850 here, the first fall anywhere on this ladder, because the frame spans further without needing heavier steel. Operators who intend to trade daily rather than seasonally usually start here, and it is the size we hold standing specification drawings for.

panels.h3: 20x12 ft - a full kitchen line behind the pass
panels.paragraph: Twelve feet of width is where a proper kitchen line becomes possible behind the counter, with the pass, the prep bench and the cold side all reachable without anyone stepping back into the customer zone. It is also the first that takes a full day to place rather than an afternoon, because the services are plumbed in rather than plugged in. The rate settles at Rs 1,776 and holds through the next size up, so the added width costs nothing per square foot.

panels.h3: 30x10 ft - ordering end and sitting end, split
panels.paragraph: Length rather than width, which keeps the unit road-friendly while adding a genuine seating section beyond the counter. This is the first size that needs a crane instead of a hydra and a 32 to 40 ft open trailer, so confirm your approach road and the standing space for lifting plant before ordering. Same Rs 1,776 rate as the 20x12, for a hundred more square feet.

panels.h3: 40x10 ft - the largest we deliver in one piece
panels.paragraph: The biggest cafe we deliver as a single piece, and the only one here that carries an ODC check before dispatch, because a 40 ft bed on Indian roads needs its route confirmed first. Four windows and eight socket positions, which is enough to run a full menu, a dessert counter and a till station without anything sharing a circuit. Its Rs 1,739 rate is the lowest we quote anywhere on this ladder. Beyond it, units are joined on site, and that junction is detailed at quotation against your frontage.
